text:
Emily (ProdMarketing): quick sync — we need to tighten the competitive angle for next week's webinar + battlecard refresh vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors. focus: predictable latency, cost controls, and private deployments. who can propose 3 lead hooks + routing rules? :rocket:

Mike (Growth): short hooks: 1) 'Predictable inference costs — no surprise overages' 2) 'One API, any deployment: hosted, dedicated, private' 3) 'Built-in fallbacks to keep features online'

Josh (Benchmarks): from the lab: rd2-8k quant4 p50 latency ~18-25% lower than two top managed endpoints in our steady-state runs. cost/unit roughly 0.6x for steady traffic patterns. i'll attach screenshots to the drive.

Anne (Content): ok — need 1-line variants for slides/tweets:
- Ship LLM features without reengineering inference. Lower cost, predictable latency, private when you need it.
- Stop trading control for speed: consistent SLOs across hosted/dedicated/private.

Tara (SalesOps): routing proposal:
- Signup contains intent checkboxes (see below).
- 'on-prem' or 'compliance' -> AE enterprise queue
- 'latency' or 'p99' concerns -> SDR (technical demo)
- 'cost optimization' -> SDR with cost-savings playbook
- high-throughput demo requests -> Mark as Dedicated prospect
How do we capture 'eval vs production' intent?

Emily (ProdMarketing): great — anne can add intent fields to the webinar signup form. also need brief objection-handlers for the battlecard. keep them one sentence.

Anne (Content): draft intent checklist (for form):
```
[ ] Proof-of-concept / research
[ ] Production deployment (>100k requests/day)
[ ] Enterprise / compliance needs (on-prem, VPC, HSM)
[ ] Latency-sensitive (p99 target <100ms)
[ ] Cost optimization priority
[ ] Looking for dedicated capacity / SLA
```

Mike (Growth): quick objection snippets: 
- Q: Why not host on cloud vendor endpoints?
- A: Managed endpoints are convenient but often lack predictable reserved capacity, unified rollout tooling, and cost controls that matter at scale.

Josh (Benchmarks): also add a tiny reproducible bench example in the battlecard:
```
curl -X POST https://bench.redwood.ai/run -d 'model=rd2-8k&quant=4bit&batch=single'
# expect: p50 lower, steady-state cost ~0.6x vs managed
```

marketing-bot: webinar created: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/next — registrants: 0 :eyes:

Emily (ProdMarketing): action items: anne draft landing + 3 tweet variants; josh upload bench screenshots and one-slide summary; mike craft 3 SDR scripts tied to the intent checkboxes; tara implement routing in Drift to map intent -> queue. review EOD Thursday. :white_check_mark:
